newsitem.title: CHINA: Quake hits East China Sea, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits East China Sea, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.1 on the Richter scale struck off the southern tip of Taiwan on Saturday, China's Xinhua news agency said.
The earthquake struck at 2.37 a.m. (1837 GMT) with its epicentre at 22.7 degrees north and 121.4 degrees east, Xinhua quoted the State Seismological Bureau as saying.
A tremor of 5.1 on the open-ended Richter scale is capable of causing widespread damage in a populated area but there were no immediate reports of casualties.
China's northwest region of Xinjiang and southwest province of Yunnan have been frequently hit by deadly quakes but tremors are less common in its eastern areas.
About 50 people have been killed in a series of earthquakes to rock the arid desert region of Xinjiang this year.
